description:
Goal
Make native tuple-field continuations publish exactly the delivered field lanes plus real captures, with no extra synthetic entry param.

Problem being fixed
After the direct-callable return transport cleanup, compiler2_native_program_matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi now reaches a real native-body shape assertion instead of the older unrelated failure mode. The tuple-field continuation body publishes 4 param reprs where the test intent and transport model require 3: two returned tuple-field lanes plus one captured pivot lane.

Concrete repro
cargo test compiler2_native_program_matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi --lib

Current failure
assertion failed: the tuple-field continuation should still carry exactly one captured pivot lane after the returned fields
left: 4
right: 3

Root cause hypothesis
This sits in the native continuation entry-signature seam, not in callable witness settlement. Native continuation entry shaping still duplicates one transport lane or synthetic param when combining delivered tuple-field result lanes with capture lanes. The failure surfaced once direct-callable return transport stopped crashing earlier.

Design decision
Fix the native continuation signature/data-model seam directly. Do not paper over it in tests and do not route tuple-field returns back through whole-value transport. Keep one transport rule: internal continuation params are the delivered result lanes followed by true capture lanes.

Code seams
- src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs entry_signature / bind_entry_input / continuation helpers
- any matching NativeBody or codegen assumption that still counts an extra synthetic tuple slot for native tuple-field continuations

Checks
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi --lib
- cargo test compiler2_interp_runs_quicksort_from_backend_artifacts --lib
- any nearby quicksort / partition tuple-field transport proofs stay green
title: Compiler2 native tuple-field continuations over-publish entry params
